::: {#def-cycle-graph}
#### Cycle graph

For an integer $n \ge 3$, a **cycle graph** $C_n$ [@wikipedia_cycle_graph] is a simple graph (@def-simple-graph) with vertices $v_1, \ldots, v_n$
and the $n$ edges

$$
\set{v_1, v_2}, \set{v_2, v_3}, \ldots, \set{v_{n - 1}, v_n}, \set{v_n, v_1}.
$$

Going along these edges in order from $v_1$ visits every vertex and returns to $v_1$.
Two cycle graphs with $n$ vertices differ only in the names of their vertices,
so we write $C_n$ for any of them.

:::
